title: The school
content: When I was in the school, I had supernatural abilities, even though I wasn’t aware that I did I can read super fast. I can run super fast. I will always be late for class no matter how hard I try I could never be on time. I kept going back to the school for years And every time it felt so familiar I didn’t realize when you are really mean. I also used to be trying to get to class in every time. I will feel like I’m in trouble. I’m late. I’m gonna get in trouble and as I’m walking past the classes, I couldn’t resist looking in the classes and I wanted to go in each class. Every class I got a stronger urge to go into the class until finally I will go into one of the classes then look up for a minute to realize I’m late again. This was crazy now I’m wondering if all of this has to do with that gate program, I want to know what they did to us and I’m gonna find out follow me on TikTok at aero.alchemy or cola.369
